crossRefs.note: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me…
This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’
I have seen, and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold…
One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains…
You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after…

parallels.note: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say…
They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe…

translations.web: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’
translations.bsb: They deliberated among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why did you not believe him?’
translations.kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?
translations.asv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why did ye not believe him?
